```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Trade Volume & Trade Balance Ratio Dashboard"),

  fluidRow(
    column(6, selectInput("country", "Select Country",
                          choices = countries,
                          selected = countries[1])),
    column(6, checkboxInput("show_regression", "Show Regression Results", TRUE))
  ),

  # Two plots, stacked vertically
  fluidRow(
    column(12, plotOutput("volume_plot", height = 300)),
    column(12, plotOutput("trade_plot", height = 300))
  ),

  tags$br(),

  conditionalPanel(
    condition = "input.show_regression == true",
    h4("Regression Results (Trade Volume ~ GDP + CPI + Trade Balance Ratio)"),
    tableOutput("regression_tbl"),
    tags$br(),
    h4("Summary Statistics (Trade Volume & Trade Ratio)"),
    tableOutput("summary_tbl")
  )
)

# ---- SERVER ----
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Reactive dataset by selected country
  series <- reactive({
    req(input$country)
    clean_df %>% filter(Country == input$country)
  })

  # ---- Plot 1: Trade Volume ----
 output$volume_plot <- renderPlot({
  df <- series()

  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(Year), y = trade_volume)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Trade Volume by Year —", input$country),
      x = "Year", y = "Trade Volume (US$)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
})

# ---- Plot 2: Trade Balance Ratio (Discrete by Year, bar style) ----
output$trade_plot <- renderPlot({
  df <- series()

  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(Year), y = trade_balance_ratio)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#d62728", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Trade Balance Ratio by Year —", input$country),
      x = "Year", y = "Trade Balance Ratio"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
})

  # ---- Regression Table ----
  output$regression_tbl <- renderTable({
    df <- series()
    if (nrow(df) < 3) {
      return(tibble(Message = "Not enough data points for regression."))
    }

    model <- lm(trade_volume ~ GDP_Current_USD + CPI_Annual + trade_balance_ratio, data = df)

    broom::tidy(model) %>%
      mutate(
        estimate = round(estimate, 3),
        std.error = round(std.error, 3),
        p.value = round(p.value, 4),
        Significance = case_when(
          p.value < 0.01 ~ "***",
          p.value < 0.05 ~ "**",
          p.value < 0.1  ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        )
      ) %>%
      select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, Significance)
  })

  # ---- Summary Table ----
  output$summary_tbl <- renderTable({
    df <- series()
    tibble(
      Variable = c("Trade Volume", "Trade Ratio"),
      Mean = c(mean(df$trade_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
               mean(df$trade_balance_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
      SD = c(sd(df$trade_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
             sd(df$trade_balance_ratio, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) %>%
      mutate(CV = round((SD / Mean) * 100, 2))
  }, align = "lrrr", rownames = FALSE)
}

# ---- Run App ----
shinyApp(ui, server)

```

```{r}
years <- sort(unique(clean_df$Year))
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# ---- UI ----
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Trade Volume Dashboard"),

  fluidRow(
    column(6, selectInput("year", "Select Year",
                          choices = years,
                          selected = years[1]))
  ),

  fluidRow(
    column(12, plotOutput("map_plot", height = "650px"))
  ),

  tags$br(),
  p("Trade volume by country (exports + imports) for the selected year.",
    style = "font-size:13px; color:#555;")
)

# ---- SERVER ----
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  series <- reactive({
    req(input$year)
    clean_df %>% filter(Year == input$year)
  })

  output$map_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- series()

    # Merge directly without renaming
    map_data <- world %>%
      left_join(df, by = c("name" = "Country"))

    # Identify top trading partner
    top_country <- df %>%
      filter(trade_volume == max(trade_volume, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      pull(Country)

    # Static ggplot map
    ggplot(map_data) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = trade_volume), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "plasma",    # “plasma”, “magma”, “inferno”,“viridis”
        direction = 1,              # 1 = low→high, -1 = reverse
        na.value = "gray90",
        labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale()),
        name = "Trade Volume (US$)"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("U.S. Trade Volume by Country —", input$year),
        subtitle = paste("Top trading partner:", top_country),
        caption = "Data source: your dataset"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "aliceblue"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
      )
  })
}

# ---- Run App ----
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

#QUESTION 4

```{r}

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Trade Balance Stability with the U.S.(2015 through 2023)"),
  fluidRow(
    column(
      8,
      leafletOutput("map", height = 600),
      tags$small("CV = sd(Balance) / mean(|Balance|); lower = more stable.")
    ),
    column(
      4,
      h4("Hovered / Selected"),
      uiOutput("info_box"),
      hr(),
      h4("Rank by Stability (low CV = rank 1)"),
      DTOutput("rank_tbl")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session){

  # -------- 1) Load & prep your data --------
  data <- read_csv("cleaned_data.csv")

  export_col <- "Total.Export.US"
  import_col <- "Total.Import.US"

  df_bal <- data %>%
    filter(Commodity == "All Commodities") %>%
    mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year)) %>%
    group_by(Country, Year) %>%
    summarise(
      Exports = sum(.data[[export_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Imports = sum(.data[[import_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Balance = Exports - Imports) %>%
    ungroup()

  cv_by_country <- df_bal %>%
    group_by(Country) %>%
    summarise(
      n_years      = n(),
      mean_balance = mean(Balance, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_balance   = sd(Balance,   na.rm = TRUE),
      denom        = mean(abs(Balance), na.rm = TRUE),
      cv_balance   = ifelse(denom > 0, sd_balance / denom, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_years >= 5)

  # rank: 1 = most stable (lowest CV)
  cv_by_country <- cv_by_country %>%
    arrange(cv_balance) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())

  # -------- 2) World polygons + merge --------
  world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
    st_transform(4326) |>
    mutate(iso3 = iso_a3)

  cv_map <- cv_by_country %>%
    mutate(iso3 = countrycode(Country, "country.name", "iso3c"))

  world_cv <- world %>%
    left_join(cv_map, by = c("iso3" = "iso3"))

  # -------- 3) Palette & labels --------
  pal <- colorBin(viridis(7, option = "C"),
                  domain = world_cv$cv_balance,
                  bins   = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, Inf),
                  na.color = "#F0F0F0")

  fmt_cv <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", percent(x, accuracy = 0.1))

  labels <- sprintf(
    "<b>%s</b><br/>CV: %s<br/>Rank: %s",
    world_cv$name_long,
    fmt_cv(world_cv$cv_balance),
    ifelse(is.na(world_cv$rank), "—", world_cv$rank)
  ) |>
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)

  # -------- 4) Map --------
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(world_cv, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 1, maxZoom = 8)) |>
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
      addPolygons(
        weight = 0.5,
        color = "#ffffff",
        opacity = 1,
        fillColor = ~pal(cv_balance),
        fillOpacity = 0.9,
        label = labels,
        layerId = ~name_long,
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333", bringToFront = TRUE)
      ) |>
      addLegend(
        position = "bottomright",
        pal = pal, values = world_cv$cv_balance,
        title = "CV (balance)", opacity = 1,
        labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) x, digits = 2,
                                suffix = "", between = " – ")
      )
  })

  # -------- 5) Info box updates on hover/click --------
  # Prefer click; if you want hover, use input$map_shape_mouseover
  cur_country <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  observeEvent(input$map_shape_mouseover, {
    cur_country(input$map_shape_mouseover$id)
  })
  observeEvent(input$map_shape_click, {
    cur_country(input$map_shape_click$id)
  })

  output$info_box <- renderUI({
    nm <- cur_country()
    row <- world_cv |> filter(name_long == nm)
    if (nrow(row) == 0) {
      div(em("Hover or click a country"))
    } else {
      cv <- row$cv_balance[1]
      rk <- row$rank[1]
      div(
        tags$h5(nm),
        tags$p(HTML(sprintf("CV: <b>%s</b><br/>Rank: <b>%s</b>",
                            fmt_cv(cv), ifelse(is.na(rk), "—", rk))))
      )
    }
  })

  # -------- 6) Rank table (sortable/searchable) --------
  rank_tbl_data <- cv_by_country %>%
    select(Country, cv_balance, rank) %>%
    arrange(rank) %>%
    mutate(`CV (balance)` = fmt_cv(cv_balance)) %>%
    select(Rank = rank, Country, `CV (balance)`)

  output$rank_tbl <- renderDT({
    datatable(rank_tbl_data, rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 10, order = list(list(0, 'asc'))))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```


#QUESTION 1

#PRODUCT SUBSTITUTION

#Approximate the Tariff presure for each commodity in every year, based on import weights
#Add column for total import & export for each commodity in every year

```{r}


product_sum = data %>% 
  mutate(commodity_code = as.character(commodity_code)) %>% 
  group_by(commodity_code, Year) %>%
  mutate(grp_import = sum(Total.Import.US, na.rm = TRUE),
         weight = if_else(grp_import > 0, Total.Import.US / grp_import, NA_real_)) %>% 
  summarise(total_import = sum(Total.Import.US, na.rm = TRUE),
          total_export = sum(Total.Export.US, na.rm = TRUE),
          tbr_weighted = sum(trade_balance_ratio * weight, na.rm = TRUE),
          tbr_sd = sd(trade_balance_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(commodity_code, Year) %>% 
  group_by(commodity_code) %>% 
  mutate(weighted_tbr_change = tbr_weighted - lag(tbr_weighted),
         import_change_pct = (total_import - lag(total_import))/ lag(total_import),
         export_change_pct = (total_export - lag(total_export))/ lag(total_export)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

# this just capture the overall tariff pressure experienced by a category --> how much the category was affected over time.
#but ignore the variation of tariff pressure apply for each country for each category
#if the tariff are applied unevenly among countries --> the standard deviation is bigger 



unique_code_name <- data %>%
  mutate(commodity_code = as.character(commodity_code)) %>%
  group_by(commodity_code, commodity_name) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            impsum = sum(Total.Import.US, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(commodity_code, desc(n), desc(impsum)) %>%
  group_by(commodity_code) %>% slice(1L) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(commodity_code, commodity_name)

unique_code_name_extra = data %>% 
  mutate(commodity_code = as.character(commodity_code)) %>%
  distinct(commodity_code, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(Commodity, commodity_code) 

product_sum <- product_sum %>%
  left_join(unique_code_name, by = "commodity_code") %>%
  left_join(unique_code_name_extra, by = "commodity_code") %>% 
  relocate(commodity_code,commodity_name, Commodity, .before = Year)
```

```{r}
# helper: safe correlation
safe_cor <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) >= 2 && sd(x[ok]) > 0 && sd(y[ok]) > 0) cor(x[ok], y[ok]) else NA_real_
}

# add 4-digit subsector column
product_sum <- product_sum %>%
  mutate(
    subsector4 = substr(commodity_code, 1, 4),
    sector3    = substr(commodity_code, 1, 3)
  )

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Product Substitution by 4-digit Subsector (ΔTBR vs ΔImport)"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        "subsector4", "Choose a subsector (4-digit):",
        choices = sort(unique(product_sum$subsector4)),
        selected = sort(unique(product_sum$subsector4))[1]
      ),
      sliderInput(
        "year_range", "Year range:",
        min = min(product_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(product_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        value = c(min(product_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE), max(product_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE)),
        step = 1, sep = ""
      ),
      numericInput("min_pairs", "Min. complete year-pairs per commodity:", 3, min = 2, max = 9, step = 1),
      numericInput("topn", "Show top N (most negative correlations):", 15, min = 5, max = 50, step = 1)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Ranking",
                 plotOutput("rank_plot", height = 480),
                 DTOutput("rank_table")),
        tabPanel("Scatter (per commodity)",
                 uiOutput("pick_products_ui"),
                 plotOutput("scatter_plot", height = 520)),

                 plotOutput("coverage_plot", height = 320))
      )
    )

)



server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # filter to chosen 4-digit subsector and year range
  subsector_df <- reactive({
    req(input$subsector4)
    product_sum %>%
      filter(subsector4 == input$subsector4,
             Year >= input$year_range[1],
             Year <= input$year_range[2])
  })

  # compute per-commodity correlation within the chosen subsector
  subsector_corr <- reactive({
    df <- subsector_df()
    df %>%
      group_by(commodity_code, Commodity) %>%   # <-- use your combined label column
      summarise(
        n_pairs        = sum(is.finite(weighted_tbr_change) & is.finite(import_change_pct)),
        cor_tbr_import = safe_cor(weighted_tbr_change, import_change_pct),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(n_pairs >= input$min_pairs, !is.na(cor_tbr_import)) %>%
      arrange(cor_tbr_import)
  })

  # ranking bar chart (y-axis uses your combined 'commodity' label)
  output$rank_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- subsector_corr() %>% slice_head(n = input$topn)
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No commodities meet the filters. Try lowering Min. pairs or widening the year range."))
    ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Commodity, cor_tbr_import), y = cor_tbr_import)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Subsector ", input$subsector4, " — Substitution signal (ΔTBR vs ΔImport)"),
        x = NULL, y = "Correlation (more negative = stronger substitution)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  })

  # ranking data table (show code + your combined label)
  output$rank_table <- renderDT({
    subsector_corr() %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
      select(rank, commodity_code, Commodity, n_pairs, cor_tbr_import) %>%
      datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10))
  })

  # product picker (value = code, label = your combined 'commodity')
  output$pick_products_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- subsector_corr() %>% slice_head(n = input$topn)
    choices <- setNames(df$commodity_code, df$Commodity)  # label shows "code + name" from your column
    selectizeInput("pick_codes", "Choose commodities to plot:",
                   choices = choices, multiple = TRUE,
                   selected = head(df$commodity_code, min(3, length(df$commodity_code))))
  })

  # scatter: ΔTBR vs ΔImport for selected commodities (color legend shows your 'commodity' label)
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(input$pick_codes)
    df <- subsector_df() %>% filter(commodity_code %in% input$pick_codes)
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for selected commodities / years"))
    ggplot(df, aes(x = weighted_tbr_change, y = import_change_pct, color = Commodity)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("ΔTBR vs ΔImport (%) — Subsector ", input$subsector4),
        x = "ΔTBR (tariff-pressure change)", y = "Δ Import (%)", color = "Commodity"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  })

  # trends: import levels over time (group/color by your 'commodity' label)
  output$trend_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(input$pick_codes)
    df <- subsector_df() %>% filter(commodity_code %in% input$pick_codes)
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for selected commodities / years"))
    ggplot(df, aes(x = Year, y = total_import, color = Commodity, group = Commodity)) +
      geom_line() + geom_point() +
      scale_y_continuous(label = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale()), expand = c(0,0,0.1,0.1)) +
      labs(title = paste0("Import levels over time — Subsector ", input$subsector4),
           y = "Total Import (US$)", color = "Commodity") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  })

  # coverage: how many years per commodity (uses your 'commodity' label)
  output$coverage_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- subsector_df() %>%
      group_by(Commodity) %>%
      summarise(n_years = n_distinct(Year), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(n_years, Commodity)
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data in this subsector / year range"))
    ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Commodity, n_years), y = n_years)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = "Year coverage per commodity", x = NULL, y = "Distinct years") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)



```




#GEOGRAPHIC SUBSTITUTION

```{r}


geo_sum = data %>%
  mutate(commodity_code = as.character(commodity_code)) %>%
  filter(str_length(commodity_code) == 4) %>%
  group_by(Year, commodity_code) %>%
  mutate(import_share = Total.Import.US / sum(Total.Import.US, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  arrange(Country, commodity_code, Year) %>%
  group_by(Country, commodity_code) %>%
  mutate(
    tbr_change = trade_balance_ratio - lag(trade_balance_ratio),
    import_share_change = import_share - lag(import_share)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


geo_correlation <- geo_sum %>%
  group_by(commodity_code, commodity_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_complete = sum(complete.cases(tbr_change, import_share_change)),
    cor_geo = ifelse(
      n_complete >= 2,
      cor(tbr_change, import_share_change, use = "complete.obs"),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cor_geo)) %>%
  arrange(cor_geo)




```



```{r}


safe_cor <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) >= 2 && sd(x[ok]) > 0 && sd(y[ok]) > 0) cor(x[ok], y[ok]) else NA_real_
}




geo_sum <- geo_sum %>%
  mutate(commodity_code = as.character(commodity_code),
         Year = as.integer(Year)) %>%
  filter(str_length(commodity_code) == 4)


ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Geographic Substitution — Industry × Country"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      # Industry selector (label shows "code — name")
      selectInput("industry4", "Choose Industry (4-digit):", choices = NULL, width = "100%"),
      # Countries selector depends on industry
      selectizeInput("countries", "Choose Countries:", choices = NULL, multiple = TRUE, width = "100%"),
      sliderInput(
        "year_range", "Year range:",
        min = min(geo_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(geo_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        value = c(min(geo_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE), max(geo_sum$Year, na.rm = TRUE)),
        step = 1, sep = ""
      ),
      numericInput("min_pairs", "Min. complete year-pairs per country:", 3, min = 2, max = 9, step = 1),
      helpText("Correlation is between ΔTBR and Δ Import% (YoY) per country.")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Import value",  br(), plotOutput("p_value", height = 420)),
        tabPanel("ΔImport% vs ΔTBR", br(), plotOutput("p_scatter", height = 420)),
        tabPanel("Correlation",   br(),
                 verbatimTextOutput("overall_cor"),
                 DTOutput("tbl_cor"))
      )
    )
  )
)


server <- function(input, output, session){

 
  observe({
    ind_choices <- geo_sum %>%
      distinct(commodity_code, commodity_name) %>%
      arrange(commodity_code, commodity_name) %>%
      mutate(lbl = paste0(commodity_code, " — ", commodity_name))
    updateSelectInput(session, "industry4",
      choices = setNames(ind_choices$commodity_code, ind_choices$lbl),
      selected = ind_choices$commodity_code[1]
    )
  })

  
  observeEvent(input$industry4, {
    req(input$industry4)
    cty <- geo_sum %>%
      filter(commodity_code == input$industry4) %>%
      distinct(Country) %>%
      arrange(Country) %>%
      pull(Country)
    updateSelectizeInput(session, "countries",
      choices = cty,
      selected = head(cty, min(4, length(cty)))
    )
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

 
  d_industry <- reactive({
    req(input$industry4)
    geo_sum %>%
      filter(commodity_code == input$industry4,
             Year >= input$year_range[1],
             Year <= input$year_range[2])
  })

  
  d_change <- reactive({
    df <- d_industry()
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data in this industry/year range."))
    df %>%
      arrange(Country, Year) %>%
      group_by(Country) %>%
      mutate(
        import_change_pct = (Total.Import.US - lag(Total.Import.US)) / lag(Total.Import.US),
        tbr_change_local  = trade_balance_ratio - lag(trade_balance_ratio)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  })

  
  d_selected <- reactive({
    req(input$countries)
    d_change() %>% filter(Country %in% input$countries)
  })

 

  # 1) Import value over time
  output$p_value <- renderPlot({
    d <- d_selected()
    validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No rows for selected countries."))
    ggplot(d, aes(x = Year, y = Total.Import.US, color = Country, group = Country)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale(), big.mark=",")) +
      labs(title = "Import value over time",
           x = "Year", y = "Import value (US$)") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
            axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            legend.text  = element_text(size = 14))
  })

  # 2) YoY % change in import value
 output$p_scatter <- renderPlot({
  d <- d_selected() %>% 
       filter(is.finite(import_change_pct), is.finite(tbr_change_local))
  validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "Not enough consecutive years to compute Δs for the selected countries."))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = tbr_change_local, y = import_change_pct, color = Country)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(
      title = "ΔImport% vs ΔTBR (per selected countries)",
      x = "ΔTBR (year-over-year)",
      y = "Δ Import (%)",
      color = "Country"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14))
})



  # per-country correlation table (ΔTBR vs ΔImport%)
  country_cor <- reactive({
    d <- d_selected()
    d %>%
      group_by(Country) %>%
      summarise(
        n_pairs = sum(is.finite(tbr_change_local) & is.finite(import_change_pct)),
        cor_geo = safe_cor(tbr_change_local, import_change_pct),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(n_pairs >= input$min_pairs, !is.na(cor_geo)) %>%
      arrange(cor_geo)
  })

  # overall pooled correlation across selected countries
  output$overall_cor <- renderText({
    d <- d_selected() %>% filter(is.finite(tbr_change_local), is.finite(import_change_pct))
    if (nrow(d) < 2 || sd(d$tbr_change_local) == 0 || sd(d$import_change_pct) == 0) {
      return("Overall correlation (ΔTBR vs ΔImport%): NA (insufficient variation).")
    }
    paste0(
      "Overall correlation (ΔTBR vs ΔImport%) — selected industry & countries: ",
      round(cor(d$tbr_change_local, d$import_change_pct), 3)
    )
  })

  output$tbl_cor <- renderDT({
    df <- country_cor()
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No countries meet the minimum complete-pairs requirement."))
    datatable(df, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10),
              colnames = c("Country", "Complete pairs", "Correlation (ΔTBR, ΔImport%)")) %>%
      formatRound("cor_geo", 3)
  })

}

shinyApp(ui, server)




```
